{{Vanilla|Shipwreck}}
A '''shipwreck''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot: treasure chests contain [[The Divine Comedy]] or [[Paradise Lost]] and ores from the pack's treasure table, supply chests contain [[sturdy leather]] armor, and map chests contain one of the pack's [[Compass|compasses]].

The [[Archaeologist]] sells Shipwreck Maps at level 1. See [[Explorer maps]].
